featureIntroducing: tauri default → compression / config; plist default (serde) pulls quick-xml default
runtimeReachability: plist parses Apple property-list XML. On Windows MSVC desktop the runtime path is build/codegen and Tauri resource/config tooling — not Branch pairing HTTP or WCM. Remote DoS requires feeding attacker-controlled multi-megabyte XML with tens of thousands of attributes into plist/quick-xml attribute iteration. Binexus does not accept untrusted plist/XML over the pairing surface.
binexusImpact: Availability DoS only if untrusted XML is parsed via plist; pairing/crypto/config.json paths do not use quick-xml.
whyCannotUpdate: plist 1.8.0 requires quick-xml ^0.38.0; cargo cannot select 0.41.0. Updating plist alone is not published against tauri-utils 2.9.3 in the approved Tauri 2.11.5 matrix.
mitigation: Do not parse untrusted XML/plist in product code; pairing uses JSON only; Branch URL policy rejects public/metadata hosts.
removalCondition: Bump approved Tauri matrix to a release whose tauri-utils/plist pulls quick-xml >= 0.41.0, then remove this ignore and re-run cargo audit clean.

runtimeReachability: NsReader unbounded namespace-declaration allocation. Same plist path as 0194; not on Branch pairing JSON. Untrusted XML would be required.
binexusImpact: Memory exhaustion DoS only if untrusted namespaced XML is parsed via plist NsReader; not reachable from pairing ceremony.
whyCannotUpdate: Identical constraint: plist 1.8.0 pins quick-xml ^0.38; incompatible with 0.41 without upstream Tauri/plist bump.
mitigation: No product code constructs NsReader on attacker input; CI secret-scan and CSP limit unintended content loading.
removalCondition: Same as RUSTSEC-2026-0194 — Tauri matrix bump that resolves quick-xml >= 0.41.0.

dependencyPath: binexus-desktop → tauri 2.11.5 → cookie 0.18.1 → time 0.3.44; also wry → cookie; also plist → time
featureIntroducing: tauri default (wry/webview) → cookie; plist default → time
runtimeReachability: Cookie date parsing can stack-exhaust on crafted Set-Cookie. WebView2 may process cookies when navigating; pairing BranchClient uses reqwest with no cookie jar for ceremony HTTP.
binexusImpact: Theoretical WebView cookie DoS if a loaded origin returns pathological Set-Cookie. Pairing HTTP itself does not use cookie/time parsing.
whyCannotUpdate: Direct cargo update -p time --precise 0.3.47 not verified across cookie/plist within locked Tauri 2.11.5; defer to matrix bump rather than silent [patch].
mitigation: Branch URL policy restricts navigation targets to loopback/private literals; CSP; pairing API is JSON over reqwest without cookies.
removalCondition: Tauri matrix bump or verified cargo update of time to >=0.3.47 that keeps tauri 2.11.5 building; then remove ignore.
